project2.description: Web application developed during my internship at Provençale SA and deployed on the company’s internal servers for employee use. Secure authentication is implemented via the company’s OAuth2/AD FS infrastructure. The screenshots provided are approximate representations based on fictitious data, in order to comply with company confidentiality requirements.
